title: Forearm & Wrist Aids
description: Elbow supports, wrist splints, and wrist braces for tennis elbow, carpal tunnel, post-fracture, and overuse injury management.

products.name: Elbow Support
features: Neoprene sleeve with targeted compression zone over the elbow
Non-slip inner silicone lining keeps support in position
Thin-profile fits under clothing without bulk
Breathable fabric for extended daytime wear
benefits: Provides warmth and compression to reduce elbow joint pain and swelling
Supports the elbow after contusions, sprains, and minor ligament injuries
Retains therapeutic heat to relax the surrounding musculature
Suitable for daily wear during work and light physical activity

products.name: Tennis Elbow Support
features: Targeted pressure pad directly over the common extensor origin
Adjustable velcro strap allows fine-tuning of compression level
Breathable neoprene band minimises skin irritation
Low-profile design does not restrict wrist or elbow movement
benefits: Disperses tensile forces away from the inflamed lateral epicondyle
Reduces forearm extensor muscle activity to relieve pain during gripping
Effective for both tennis elbow and golfer's elbow
Allows continued activity while the tendon heals

products.name: Wrist Splint
features: Removable palmar aluminium stay maintains the wrist in neutral position
Perforated fabric for ventilation and moisture management
Adjustable velcro straps accommodate swelling and different wrist sizes
Thumb hole keeps the splint correctly positioned
benefits: Immobilises the wrist to relieve pain from carpal tunnel syndrome and tendinitis
Prevents inadvertent wrist flexion and extension that aggravates symptoms
Can be worn overnight to manage nocturnal paraesthesia in carpal tunnel syndrome
Used post-fracture to maintain alignment during conservative management

products.name: Wrist Brace
features: Semi-rigid structure with flexible stays for controlled wrist support
Wraparound design with multiple velcro closures for a custom fit
Breathable material suitable for extended daytime wear
Allows finger movement while restricting excessive wrist motion
benefits: Stabilises the wrist joint during rehabilitation from sprains and strains
Reduces the risk of re-injury during return to work or sport
Limits painful wrist deviation without fully immobilising the hand
Suitable for occupational use in repetitive-motion jobs

products.name: Wrist Brace with Thumb
features: Integrated thumb spica extension immobilises the thumb CMC joint
Removable stays allow customisable rigidity
Open finger design preserves grip function
Dual-layer fabric for comfort and durability
benefits: Supports De Quervain's tenosynovitis and gamekeeper's thumb injuries
Restricts thumb and wrist movement simultaneously to protect healing structures
Reduces pain during pinch and grip activities
Suitable for post-cast removal rehabilitation and chronic thumb instability
